author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Seth Johnson recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Philadelphia Phillies recalled Seth Johnson from Triple-A Lehigh Valley on Thursday.
impact: Johnson will take Brad Keller's spot in the bullpen after Keller landed on the injured list with a UCL tear that could sideline him for the remainder of the season. The 27-year-old has posted a 7.15 ERA and 1.68 WHIP across 11.1 innings this season and will need to make an immediate impact to stick in the Phillies' bullpen long term.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Brad Keller sidelined with UCL tear
desc: The Philadelphia Phillies have placed Brad Keller on the 15-day injured list with a right elbow UCL tear.
impact: Keller was activated from the 15-day injured list on July 8 after recovering from right forearm tendinitis, but he returns to the injured list after making just one appearance. He has posted a 4.02 ERA and 1.34 WHIP across 31.1 innings this season. Given that he has a UCL tear, he is likely to miss the remainder of the season. The Phillies recalled Seth Johnson from Triple-A Lehigh Valley to take his spot in the bullpen.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Geraldo Perdomo (wrist) receives cortisone injection over All-Star break
desc: Geraldo Perdomo received a cortisone injection during the All-Star break.
impact: Perdomo has been dealing with left wrist inflammation, so he received a cortisone injection during the All-Star break to help alleviate the issue. The injection is not expected to affect his availability for Friday's game against the St. Louis Cardinals. He has slashed .241/.354/.356 with six home runs across 92 games this season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Tyler Locklear to be promoted to majors
desc: The Arizona Diamondbacks are expected to promote Tyler Locklear to the major league roster ahead of Friday's game against the St. Louis Cardinals.
impact: With Tommy Troy (shoulder) landing on the injured list, Locklear will take his spot on the active roster. Locklear has slashed .313/.394/.502 with eight home runs across 211 at-bats at Triple-A Reno this season. He should see plenty of playing time with Arizona, splitting time between first base and designated hitter.

author: Ari Koslow
title: MacKenzie Gore to start Saturday
desc: MacKenzie Gore will start for the Rangers on Saturday against the Braves.
impact: Gore struggled heavily across the first half of the season. He'll be looking to get back on track the rest of the way as the Rangers compete in the AL West.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Robert Hassell III traded to Pirates
desc: The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired Robert Hassell III from the Washington Nationals for cash considerations or a player to be named later.
impact: Hassell appeared in 70 games for Washington last season, slashing .223/.257/.315. He has yet to receive a big-league opportunity this season as he's posted a .215/.304/.289 slash line at Triple-A Rochester. He'll get a fresh start with Pittsburgh, though he's likely to begin his tenure with the organization in the minors.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cal Quantrill to start Friday for Rangers
desc: Cal Quantrill will start on Friday against the Braves.
impact: Quantrill will take the mound first out of the All-Star break for Texas. He posted a 2.45 ERA across two starts in July before the break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jacob deGrom uncertain on when next start will be
desc: The Rangers are uncertain when Jacob deGrom will make his next start.
impact: Cal Quantrill and MacKenzie Gore will open out of the All-Star break for Texas on Friday and Saturday. They're leaving Sunday open, so that could be when deGrom makes his next start.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Will Smith (neck) without timetable to return
desc: Will Smith remains without a clear timetable to return from his neck injury.
impact: Smith has been swinging, but he hasn't been able to progress any further. Dalton Rushing will continue to see more playing time behind the plate for the Dodgers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Glasnow (back) throws bullpen
desc: Tyler Glasnow threw a bullpen session last weekend.
impact: Glasnow is continuing to progress slowly. He is likely looking at a potential return in August.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Enrique Hernandez (oblique) to begin rehab assignment
desc: Enrique Hernandez is expected to begin a rehab assignment.
impact: Hernandez could be activated from the injured list by July 28. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zack Short designated for assignment
desc: The Mets designated Zack Short for assignment.
impact: Short loses his spot on the Mets 40-man roster. He will head to waivers as a result.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Marcus Semien (hip) activated from IL
desc: The Mets activated Marcus Semien from the injured list.
impact: Semien used the All-Star break to go on a rehab assignment. He'll return for Thursday's series opener against the Phillies.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Eury Perez to start Sunday
desc: Eury Perez will start for the Marlins on Sunday against the Brewers.
impact: Perez will close out the first series out of the All-Star break for Miami. He has allowed two runs or less in four straight starts since returning from the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Meyer to start Saturday
desc: Max Meyer will start on Saturday against the Brewers.
impact: Meyer posted a stifling 2.58 ERA during the first half of the season. He'll look to continue that with one of the top teams in all of baseball.
